verdict.rationale: Factory's docs explicitly state users can 'Connect Jira, Notion, Slack, Linear, PagerDuty, and MCP tools' and list 'MCP tools' as a supported feature in the Droid CLI/App runtime, plus a dedicated MCP docs page is referenced. This shows first-party support for plugging in MCP servers so the agent can use their tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of MCP server setup and any detail on configuration steps or limitations.
